response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scancount, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY si.healtheval), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS mean_avg FROM s) SELECT s.status, s.total_scancount, s.avg_gb_per_min, s.avg_gb_per_min - m.mean_avg AS gap_from_mean FROM s CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The date range is inclusive at both ends (BETWEEN), comparing chronotag cast to text against the given strings.

The average GB per scan minute is the mean of the per-scan ratios gbsize/spanmin. Scans with a NULL gbsize or spanmin, or a zero spanmin, are skipped in the average. They still count toward total scancount.
The mean of the status-level averages is the unweighted mean across statuses. Statuses whose average is NULL are ignored in that mean. If the mean is NULL, no rows are returned.
The inner join to sites drops scans with no matching site. A NULL healtheval, if present, forms its own group.
